test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow's from the given statements.

**Statements:** Some schools are big. All big are malls. No mall is cheap.

**Conclusion I:** All big are schools.

**Conclusion II: **Some malls are big.
solution:
**Given:**

Statements:

Some schools are big.

All big are malls.

No mall is cheap.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce0a5ea3127ea2e0d2f5c23dbcdc69a9ac8f384c42ccf18c3a099cfe83e4fb96.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All big are schools → **False** (It is given that some school are big. So, all big are school can never be possible.)

II. Some malls are big → **True** (It is given that all big are mall. So, some part of mall is big.)

So, **only conclusion II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 2'.***
